name: WhatsScale
desc: Send WhatsApp messages, manage contacts, and automate conversations via WAHA

actions.name: whatsscale_send_text_to_contact
actions.displayName: Send a Message to a Contact
actions.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp contact selected from your contact list

actions.name: whatsscale_send_text_to_group
actions.displayName: Send a Message to a Group
actions.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp group selected from your group list

actions.name: whatsscale_send_text_to_channel
actions.displayName: Send a Text to a Channel
actions.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp Channel

actions.name: whatsscale_send_text_to_crm_contact
actions.displayName: Send a Message to a CRM Contact
actions.description: Send a text message to a contact from your WhatsScale CRM

actions.name: whatsscale_send_image_to_contact
actions.displayName: Send an Image to a Contact
actions.description: Send an image to a WhatsApp contact selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_image_to_group
actions.displayName: Send an Image to a Group
actions.description: Send an image to a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_image_to_channel
actions.displayName: Send an Image to a Channel
actions.description: Broadcast an image to a WhatsApp Channel selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_image_to_crm_contact
actions.displayName: Send an Image to a CRM Contact
actions.description: Send an image to a WhatsScale CRM contact selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_video_to_contact
actions.displayName: Send a Video to a Contact
actions.description: Send a video to a WhatsApp contact selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_video_to_group
actions.displayName: Send a Video to a Group
actions.description: Send a video to a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_video_to_channel
actions.displayName: Send a Video to a Channel
actions.description: Broadcast a video to a WhatsApp Channel selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_video_to_crm_contact
actions.displayName: Send a Video to a CRM Contact
actions.description: Send a video to a WhatsScale CRM contact selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_document_to_contact
actions.displayName: Send a Document to a Contact
actions.description: Send a document to a WhatsApp contact selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_document_to_group
actions.displayName: Send a Document to a Group
actions.description: Send a document to a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_document_to_crm_contact
actions.displayName: Send a Document to a CRM Contact
actions.description: Send a document to a WhatsScale CRM contact selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_get_crm_contact
actions.description: Retrieve a CRM contact by ID

actions.name: whatsscale_update_crm_contact
actions.description: Update the name or tags of an existing CRM contact

actions.name: whatsscale_delete_crm_contact
actions.description: Permanently delete a contact from your WhatsScale CRM

actions.name: whatsscale_add_crm_contact_tag
actions.displayName: Add Tags to a CRM Contact
actions.description: Add one or more tags to an existing CRM contact

actions.name: whatsscale_remove_crm_contact_tag
actions.displayName: Remove a Tag from a CRM Contact
actions.description: Remove a single tag from a CRM contact

actions.name: whatsscale_create_crm_contact
actions.description: Add a new contact to your WhatsScale CRM

actions.name: whatsscale_find_crm_contact_by_phone
actions.displayName: Find a CRM Contact by Phone
actions.description: Look up a CRM contact using their phone number

actions.name: whatsscale_list_crm_contacts
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of CRM contacts with optional filters

actions.name: whatsscale_list_crm_tags
actions.description: List every unique tag currently used across CRM contacts.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_audio_manual
actions.description: Send an audio file to a contact, group, channel, or CRM contact by ID rather than picking from a list.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_location_manual
actions.description: Send GPS coordinates to a contact, group, channel, or CRM contact by ID rather than picking from a list.

actions.name: whatsscale_send_poll_manual
actions.description: Send an interactive poll to a contact, group, channel, or CRM contact by ID rather than picking from a list.

actions.name: whatsscale_add_participants_to_group
actions.description: Add contacts to a WhatsApp group, both selected from dropdowns.

actions.name: whatsscale_remove_participants_from_group
actions.description: Remove members from a WhatsApp group, both selected from dropdowns.

actions.name: whatsscale_promote_admins_in_group
actions.description: Grant admin rights to members of a WhatsApp group, both selected from dropdowns.

actions.name: whatsscale_demote_admins_in_group
actions.description: Revoke admin rights from members of a WhatsApp group, both selected from dropdowns.

actions.name: whatsscale_leave_selected_group
actions.description: Make the connected session leave a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown.

actions.name: whatsscale_list_participants_in_group
actions.description: List the members of a WhatsApp group selected from the dropdown, and their roles.

actions.name: whatsscale_post_text_status
actions.description: Post a text-only WhatsApp Status (story) with an optional background color.

actions.name: whatsscale_post_image_status
actions.description: Post an image WhatsApp Status (story) with an optional caption.

actions.name: whatsscale_post_video_status
actions.description: Post a video WhatsApp Status (story) with an optional caption.

actions.name: whatsscale_check_whatsapp
actions.description: Check if a phone number has WhatsApp

actions.name: whatsscale_list_sessions
actions.description: List every WhatsApp session (device) connected to this account, and its status.

actions.name: whatsscale_list_whatsapp_contacts
actions.description: List the raw WhatsApp contacts synced to a session. Not the same as the WhatsScale CRM contacts.

actions.name: whatsscale_list_whatsapp_groups
actions.description: List the WhatsApp groups a session belongs to.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: watch_channel_messages
triggers.description: Triggers when a new message is posted to any WhatsApp Channel (includes own posts).

triggers.name: watch_group_messages
triggers.description: Triggers when a new message is received in any WhatsApp group.

triggers.name: watch_incoming_messages
triggers.description: Triggers when a new 1-on-1 WhatsApp message is received.

triggers.name: watch_specific_group_messages
triggers.description: Triggers when a new message is received in a specific WhatsApp group.

triggers.name: watch_specific_channel_messages
triggers.description: Triggers when a new message is posted to a specific WhatsApp Channel.
